# About haechi

haechi provides common work obligations and task skills for Claude Code and Codex. The model chooses useful methods as work develops. The [common work contract](../../principles/work-contract.md) owns pre-action evidence, implementation principles, verification, review and completion regardless of the entry skill. Hooks supply repository facts and actionable reminders; they do not classify natural-language requests or enforce a runtime completion lock.

This build provides optional setup diagnostics (`/haechi:setup`), familiar task-method commands (`bug`, `feature`, `refactor`, `perf`, `review`, `test-hardening`), focused skills (`spec`, `preview`, `sweep`, `document`, `request`, `review-diff`, `impact-map`, `mutation-check`, `sibling-path-map`), Git skills (`commit`, `mr`, `ci-watch`) and one generic worker definition. Read-only, tests-only and explicit performance-measurement boundaries remain intact.

The main session owns requirements, integration and completion. Compatible playbook/step entries still describe bounded delegated operations. `/haechi:delegate` validates the brief and assembles complete method guidance plus the common contract and its applicable principles, with source hashes. The worker has no preset model, effort or tool list; host/session settings and explicit dispatch restrictions apply. Independent review uses a separate execution. Packet validation proves composition, not delivery, compliance or correctness.

`/haechi:document` composes cross-team documents from 18 shared Parts and six situational templates. It connects existing screenshot capture procedures to separate PNG copies with numbered borders and document attachments; GIF is optional when motion matters. `/haechi:request` uses the same writing system for requests and replies.
